title: Light-activated antimicrobial coatings: the great potential of organic photosensitizers
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,7905-7925
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00272A, Review Article

Karolina Socha, Ivan Gusev, Patryk Mroczko, Agata Blacha-Grzechnik
Durable antimicrobial coatings has emerged as the one of most promising strategies for reducing the accumulation of microorganisms on high-touch surfaces. In this group, light-activated layers are of particular interest, as they are effective against broad range of pathogens.
